profile.name: Timothy Singh
profile.heroTitle: I build dependable software, automate messy workflows, and turn data into useful decisions.
profile.heroSummary: M.Sc. Data Science graduate from UBC with 4+ years of technical delivery experience across software, analytics, and public-sector systems. I have reduced onboarding time by 40%, improved asset tracking efficiency by 35%, supported 200+ staff environments, and built Python, SQL, and web-based solutions teams can actually use.
profile.availability: Open to software engineering and data analyst roles.
profile.aboutTitle: Engineering discipline, analytics, and stakeholder communication are the threads that connect my work.
aboutSummary: For software engineering teams, I bring backend and automation experience across Python, Java, Flask, REST APIs, Linux environments, and production-minded problem solving.
For data analyst teams, I bring SQL, Python, experimentation, reporting, and experience turning messy operational data into recommendations stakeholders can act on.

What makes me practical to hire is that I have already worked in support-heavy, ambiguous environments. I can understand the process, clean up the data, build the tool, and communicate the result clearly.
impactPoints: Quantified delivery: 40% faster onboarding, 35% stronger asset tracking efficiency, 1,500+ residents reached, and 85% benchmark accuracy in emissions tracking.
Hands-on with Python, SQL, Java, JavaScript, Flask, REST APIs, pandas, Power BI, and production-minded tooling.
Comfortable moving between implementation, analysis, stakeholder communication, and follow-through.
Strong academic signal with a UBC M.Sc. in Data Science and First Class Honours in Computer Science.

projects.title: MTR-Framework
projects.desc: Python package to measure and track carbon emissions from deep learning workflows using runtime metrics and regional carbon-intensity APIs.
projects.detail: Built during a UBC capstone with ALS Geoanalytics. The framework benchmarked at roughly 85% measurement accuracy against existing tools, integrated into Python and PyTorch workflows, and supported emissions-reduction experiments such as pruning and quantization.
projects.impact: Production-minded Python package design and experiment tooling

projects.title: DSResuMatch
projects.desc: Python package for analyzing resumes against job descriptions by extracting sections and scoring keyword relevance.
projects.detail: Designed for Data Science resume matching, with section extraction and scoring logic that can be adapted to new role profiles and keyword sets.
projects.impact: Python packaging, NLP pipelines, and problem framing

projects.title: Project Bloodline
projects.desc: Progressive Web Application built to encourage blood donation through a mobile-ready experience and REST-backed workflows.
projects.detail: Built with Angular 9.1.1 on the front end and Flask 1.0.2 on the back end using a JAM-style architecture, with authentication, REST APIs, and a mobile-friendly design.
projects.impact: Full-stack web delivery and API integration

projects.title: Credit Card Default Predictor
projects.desc: Ensemble modeling project for predicting credit card default risk from historical payment behavior.
projects.detail: Built on a Kaggle dataset of roughly 30,000 rows and 25 features, comparing feature-selection and feature-importance effects across XGBoost, LightGBM, and RandomForestClassifier models.
projects.impact: Feature engineering, model comparison, and risk analysis

projects.title: Wine Quality Predictor
projects.desc: ML classification project for predicting wine quality using physicochemical properties and repeatable modeling workflows.
projects.detail: Compared KNN, SVM with RBF kernel, Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, and Decision Tree approaches using feature engineering, pipelines, and cross-validation.

projects.title: NIH Chest X-Ray Classifier
projects.desc: Deep learning pipeline trained on thousands of chest X-rays to identify thoracic diseases and disorders.
projects.detail: Built during the UBC Medicine Datathon 2025 using transfer learning on DenseNet. Future improvements included image transformations and additional feature engineering.
projects.impact: Deep learning experimentation and team-based prototyping

projects.title: Robotic Arm Project
projects.desc: Simulation-driven robotics project using a Mecademic500 arm for precise pick-and-place operations.
projects.detail: Developed with ROS and Gazebo in a Linux environment in collaboration with Virtana to test motion control and automation workflows.
